描述_EN: the lotus had always been seen as a flower that 'remained unstained by the muddy surrounding', thus a symbol of uncompromised integrity. each time the scholar composed a literary work he needed to produce ink by grinding an ink cake on an inkstone, adding a small amount of water during the process. the water dropper was an important utensil in the scholar's studio. this jade water dropper in the form of a lotus leaf would have carried an additional meaning. chinese scholars liked to use writing accessories made of jade, because confucius praised jade as 'the embodiment of virtue'.
描述_ZN: 荷花一直被视为 "不受周围泥土污染 "的花朵，因此是不折不扣的诚信的象征。 每当学者创作文学作品时，他需要在砚台上磨制墨饼，在这个过程中加入少量的水。 水滴器是学者工作室的一个重要工具。 这个荷叶形式的玉水滴，会有额外的含义。 中国学者喜欢使用玉石制成的书写配件，因为孔子称赞玉石是 "美德的化身"。
